user.title: SmartFlow price traffic light
user.description: Visualises the price levels and decisions of a running Battery SmartFlow AI instance and lets you try its price settings in a simulator. Prices, currency and settings are taken from the selected instance.

abort.bsfai_missing: Battery SmartFlow AI is not installed or not set up. Install and configure it first.
abort.bsfai_not_running: Battery SmartFlow AI is set up but not running. Check its status under Settings > Devices & services.
abort.already_configured: This Battery SmartFlow AI instance already has a price traffic light.
